parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: The programming language of the application.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: SentinelEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Sentinel component.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The service where the application is deployed. The value ACK indicates Container Service for Kubernetes.

parameters.name: SwitchEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to start the switch.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The custom tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
